messages:
emily: FYI the int8 bring-up for the new reranker (v2.1 hybrid) shows a sharp MRR degradation specifically on the short-query slice (<=10 toks). NDCG@10 barely moves but MRR down ~3.4% vs fp32 on daily shadow.

sanjay: can you share the failing sample set + eval command? is this recent PTQ or a different quantization method?

emily: this was from the latest PTQ run using the global calibration corpus. eval cmd: `./bench_eval --model v2.1-int8 --holdout shortq --metrics mrr,ndcg@10 --seed=7 --batch=256`. snippet: 
```
MRR: fp32=0.427, int8=0.412
NDCG@10: fp32=0.691, int8=0.688
```

maria: small ndcg shift, big-ish MRR. sounds like top-1 reordering. did anything change in candidate priming / prefix templates?

emily: yes 1 we added a 1-line system priming for short queries to improve intent context. suspect priming + quant margin compression.

kei: have you compared logits distribution and top2/top1 margins across fp32 vs int8? margin compression is common with PTQ.

emily: pulled a top1 diff sample of 3k qids: 96 top1 flips. margin histogram shows compressed tails; mean top1-top2 margin drops from 0.63 to 0.28.

sanjay: that's significant. Two-pronged approach: (A) run slice-aware calibration (calibrate on primed shortq examples), (B) try small post-quant correction scalars on final logits per-head/layer.

emily: queued jobs on ci-small:
- job id qb-9001: slice-calib-5k-primed
- job id qb-9002: postquant-biasscan (scalar per-ffn)
- job id qb-9003: ablate-priming (remove priming, keep everything else)

eval-bot: qb-9001 finished 1 slice-calib reduced flip count to 34/3k, MRR delta improved to -0.6%.

maria: nice. that suggests calibration distribution mismatch was a big factor. does slice-calib change inference perf or memory?
\emily: negligible perf impact; calibration artifacts are just used during PTQ. model artifact size unchanged.

sanjay: for the remaining delta, try the bias-scan. tiny learned offsets can restore argmax without full retrain. also check kernel path: lengths around 8-10 may trigger special KVpack.
\emily: ran qb-9002 1 bias-scan with small grid on scalar in [-0.2,0.2], per-layer. best config yields MRR within 0.1% of fp32 but increases tail NDCG noise slightly.

kei: trade-off noted. possible solution: conditional bias only for shortq route in routing policy. low-risk rollout: enable bias for shadow first, monitor regressions.

maria: add a unit in the eval harness to compute top1 flip set and log raw logits for flips. we should automate comparison reports for every PTQ job.

emily: opened ticket RE-2387 and added owners. also drafting a short section in onboarding docs: "When adding priming templates, run slice-aware PTQ on primed inputs".

sanjay: one more ask: add leftpad/rightpad parity test to the PTQ smoke. padding side changes alignment for KV caches and sometimes interacts with quant rounding.

emily: added q-batch job qb-9004 for pad parity; job queued.

eval-bot: qb-9003 (ablate-priming) finished 1 removing priming recovered MRR fully, confirming priming is the trigger.

kei: summary action items: 1) integrate slice-aware calibration into PTQ pipeline (owner: emily), 2) implement optional small post-quant bias per-slice (owner: maria), 3) add priming PTQ checks to onboarding checklist (owner: sanjay), 4) pad-parity check in smoke tests (owner: emily).

emily: I'll land a PR with the calibration artifacts and add the flip-dump utility to eval-harness. will @sanjay and @maria on PR.

sanjay: if the bias-correction works cleanly we can deploy as config override per-route rather than model fork. keep rollback plan ready (disable priming in shortq route).

maria: agree. also add monitoring alert on daily shadowbench MRR deltas > 1% for shortq slice.

emily: noted. thanks all :thumbsup: will post logs and example dumps shortly.
